title: 立场论文：现有模型卡不足以支撑开放权重基础模型的下游治理
summary: 本文分析Hugging Face上500个模型卡，指出当前模型卡不足以治理开放权重基础模型（OWFM）的安全风险。提出需结合模型卡、可接受使用政策（AUP）和许可证三层治理框架，并指出标准开源许可证可能削弱AUP执行力。为模型卡、AUP和许可证的演进提供方向，以整合信息、规范和法律维度。
summary_en: Analyzing 500 model cards on Hugging Face, this position paper argues current model cards are insufficient for governing open-weight foundation models (OWFMs). It proposes a multi-layered governance framework integrating model cards, acceptable use policies (AUPs), and licenses, noting standard open-source licenses may weaken AUP enforceability. Offers directions for evolving these artifacts.
